estimateType: author bottom-up engineering planning intervals; low confidence; not empirical or statistical intervals
scope: Known complete support for three proposed native services in a selected Darwin/POSIX cohort, TLS selected, current Scheme/C clients, qualified native C leaves retained

estimateMethod.workUnit: one experienced engineer focused workday; includes design/implementation/review and explicitly listed future qualification effort; no native work is performed now
estimateMethod.coupling: Zig cost = same realized C difficulty cost + paired language/interface difference; common uncertainty is correlated, not independently chosen endpoints
estimateMethod.effortBands: Small bounded adapter/product edit usually 1-4 days; multi-client native integration 4-12 days; owner/phase/failure protocol plus independent evidence 8-20 days. WBS rows state source-specific judgment. Bands are planning heuristics, not source-derived durations.
estimateMethod.reuse: Credit existing C allocation, strings/TLS cleanup, pthread/OS leaves and Scheme generation in both candidates; share schema/storage/diagnostics once
estimateMethod.tails: Unknown external raw aliases, unsupported target paths, complete collector/new backend/bootstrap and failed proof or qualification can add unbounded extra work outside these planning intervals
